sections.title: Daily routines and present tense
body: Use på morgonen, på dagen, på eftermiddagen, på kvällen.
Sedan and därefter connect events; keep the verb next.
Write full jag even when speech reduces it.

examples.fi: Jag vaknar sju och äter frukost.
examples.en: I wake at seven and eat breakfast.
What do you do in the evening?
In the evening I study Swedish.

sections.title: Present tense and V2
body: Many present forms end in -r: arbetar, läser, bor. Some forms are irregular, such as är.
Verbs do not change by person: jag arbetar, hon arbetar, vi arbetar.
The finite verb is second in a main clause: På dagen arbetar jag.

assignment.title: Episode 7 mission: Daily routines and present tense
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear the audio twice and answer: Where does the speaker work?

READ: Read once for purpose and once for detail. Answer: When does Amir study Swedish?

SPEAK: Describe three moments in a weekday. Try once without the model, then repeat more clearly.

WRITE: Write four routine sentences. Check word order and spelling.

TRANSFER: Move a time phrase to the front and repair order.

RETURN: Complete På kvällen ___ jag svenska.
assignment.model:
Speaking: På morgonen dricker jag kaffe. Sedan arbetar jag. På kvällen läser jag.
Writing: På morgonen vaknar jag sju. Sedan äter jag. På dagen arbetar jag. På kvällen studerar jag.
